cases.name: Pamela Knight
cases.narrative: She went to his home to remove a 2-year-old boy from his custody and as she got out of her car, he pushed her, causing her to strike her head on the concrete driveway then stomped on her head, causing a skull fracture and brain injury. She died 4.5 months later.
